title: Farashin raka'a, karya-ko da saita farashin ku

say: Farashin raka'a, karya-ko da, da saita farashin ku.
Wannan bidiyon ne don Module 2 na Farashi, Tsararraki da Tsare-tsaren Riba.
Kudin raka'a shine abin da kuke kashewa don yin da sayar da abu ɗaya. Ga hanyar matakai hudu.
Na farko, jera kowane farashi mai canzawa don tsari ɗaya, tare da adadinsa da farashinsa na yanzu.

say: Na biyu, ƙara su kuma raba da adadin raka'a masu kyau da tsari ya bayar.

say: Kuɗin Ngozi na fulawa, sukari, margarine, qwai, mai, jakunkuna, iskar gas da mataimakiyar ta ya kai naira 47,000.

card.title: Cikakken farashin Ngozi a kowace fakiti

say: An raba ta da fakiti 50, farashinta ya kai naira 940 a fakiti.

card.title: Cikakken farashin Ngozi a kowace fakiti

say: Kudinta na wata-wata, ciki har da nata albashin Naira 60,000, jimillar Naira 110,000. An raba fakiti sama da 200, wato fakitin naira 550.

card.title: Cikakken farashin Ngozi a kowace fakiti

say: Don haka kowane fakitin ya kai Naira 1,490. Tsohon farashinta na naira 1,500 ya bar naira 10 kacal na riba.

card.title: Cikakken farashin Ngozi a kowace fakiti

say: Kowane tallace-tallace na farko yana biyan kuɗin canjin nasa. Abin da ya rage shi ne gefen gudummawar. A kan Naira 1,500, gudummawar Ngozi ya kai 1,500 ban da 940, wato fakitin Naira 560.

panel.heading: Nawa ne ka sayar?
items: Gudunmawa = farashi ya rage farashin canji
Break- even = ƙayyadaddun farashin da aka raba ta hanyar gudummawa
Koyaushe tattara har zuwa gaba ɗaya naúrar
Margin na aminci = da ake tsammanin rage karye-ko da

say: Ƙirar-ko da ƙayyadaddun farashin da aka raba ta hanyar gudummawa. 110,000 da aka raba ta 560 shine 196.4.

say: Koyaushe tattarawa. Dole ne Ngozi ta sayar da fakiti 197 duk wata don biyan kudinta da albashinta. Fakitin 198 ne kawai ke ba da riba.

say: Idan tana tsammanin sayar da fakiti 250, iyakar amincinta shine fakiti 53, kusan kashi 21 cikin ɗari. Kasa da kashi 10 cikin dari, mako guda mara kyau zai iya tura wata zuwa asara.

say: Yi amfani da karya-ko da don gwada farashi. A Naira 1,500 Ngozi na bukatar fakiti 197 a wata.
A kan Naira 1,700, gudummawar da ta bayar ya zama Naira 760, kuma tana bukatar fakiti 145 kacal. Wato ƙarancin fakiti 52 kowane wata.
Amma kar a taɓa farashi ƙasa da farashin ku. Ga Ngozi, duk farashin da bai kai naira 940 ba ya yi hasarar kuɗi akan kowane fakitin.
Markup riba ne a matsayin kashi na farashi. Kashi 30 cikin 100 na Naira 1,490 ya ba Naira 1,937. Amma wannan kusan kashi 23 ne kawai.

say: Margin riba ne a matsayin kashi na farashi. Don gefen kashi 30, raba 1,490 ta 0.70. Hakan ya bada kimanin naira 2,130.
Kasuwar ta ce ana sayar da irin wadannan fakitin har kusan naira 2,000, don haka Ngozi ta zabi naira 1,700 a yanzu kuma ta yi aikin kara girma.

card.title: Farashin man shanu na jikin Funke

say: Gilashin Funke Naira 2,000, ta kuma saye shi akan Naira 3,000. Wannan shine kashi 50 cikin dari, amma kashi 33 ne kawai.

card.title: Farashin man shanu na jikin Funke

say: Matsakaicin kashi 50 na gaskiya zai buƙaci naira 4,000. Wancan ya yi yawa ga kasuwarta, don haka sai ta daidaita akan Naira 3,500, kusan kashi 43 cikin 100. Yanzu zabi ne mai hankali.

card.title: Farashin man shanu na jikin Funke
rows: Farashin da aka zaɓa: kusan 43% gefe

say: Shaguna suna buƙatar ribar kansu, don haka suna siya akan farashi kaɗan. Idan Ngozi ta sayar wa wani shago a kan Naira 1,400, har yanzu tana ba da gudummawar Naira 460, kuma shagon yana sayar da Naira 1,700.
Ajiye jumloli sama da farashi mai canzawa, kuma saita ƙaramin tsari don samun ƙaramin farashi ta ƙara.

panel.heading: Saita farashin jumloli
items: Ka kiyaye shi sama da farashin canjin ku
Ba da gudummawa ta gaske a kowace raka'a
Saita mafi ƙarancin tsari, kamar fakiti 20
Bar dakin shago don riba

say: Don tunawa. Cikakken farashi yana canzawa tare da ƙayyadaddun farashi akan raka'a. Ƙirar-ko da ƙayyadaddun farashin da aka raba ta hanyar gudummawa, an tattara su. Ƙaramar farashin farashi zai iya yanke shi sosai. Yi amfani da dabarar gefe, ba alamar alama ba, don tazarar manufa.
Kuma kiyaye farashin jumloli sama da farashi mai canzawa.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Cikakken farashi = m + ƙayyadaddun farashin kowane raka'a
Break- even = ƙayyadaddun farashin da aka raba ta hanyar gudummawa
Ƙaramar farashin farashi na iya yanke karya-har ma da ƙarfi
Rikicin manufa: farashi = farashi / (1 rabe rabe)
Jumla dole ne ya kasance sama da farashin canji

say: Yanzu tsada raka'a ɗaya na babban samfur ɗinku, nemo madaidaicin madaidaicin-madaidaicin aminci, kuma ku saka farashi tare da duka alama da gefe kafin zaɓin.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.

panel.heading: Ayyukanku na wannan tsarin
items: Farashin raka'a ɗaya na babban samfurin ku
Nemo wurin hutun ku
Farashin samfurin ku hanyoyi biyu
